name: Rolling window: old days drop out on a later date

planSteps.description: Navigate to /?today=2026-10-19&fresh=1 (pins today to 2026-10-19 and clears saved trips)
Click the add trip button (data-testid=trip-add), enter entry 2026-05-01 and exit 2026-05-30 and click save (data-testid=trip-save)
Navigate to /?today=2026-11-15 (without fresh=1, so the saved trip is kept)
The same single trip row (data-testid=trip-row) 2026-05-01 to 2026-05-30 is shown
Days used (data-testid=days-used) now shows 11, because only 2026-05-20 to 2026-05-30 is inside the 180 days ending 2026-11-15
